name: softplus
doc: softplus：`log (1 + exp x)`（ReLU 的光滑近似）。
stmt: def softplus (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Real.log (1 + Real.exp x)

name: softplus_hasDerivAt
stmt: theorem softplus_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt softplus (sigmoid x) x
proof:
by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 + Real.exp t) (Real.exp x) x :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).const_add 1
  have hden : (1 + Real.exp x) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hlog : HasDerivAt (Real.log ∘ fun t : ℝ => 1 + Real.exp t)
      ((1 + Real.exp x)⁻¹ * Real.exp x) x :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_log hden).comp x h1
  have hval : (1 + Real.exp x)⁻¹ * Real.exp x = sigmoid x := by
    unfold sigmoid
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    have h1' : (1 + Real.exp x) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2' : (1 + (Real.exp x)⁻¹) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval] at hlog
  simpa [softplus, Function.comp_def] using hlog

name: softplus_deriv
stmt: theorem softplus_deriv (x : ℝ) : deriv softplus x = sigmoid x
proof: (softplus_hasDerivAt x).deriv

name: softplus_pos
stmt: theorem softplus_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < softplus x
proof:
by
  unfold softplus
  exact Real.log_pos (by linarith [Real.exp_pos x])

name: softplus_strictMono
doc: softplus 严格单调（用 exp/log 单调，不经导数）。
stmt: theorem softplus_strictMono : StrictMono softplus
proof:
by
  intro x y hxy
  unfold softplus
  exact Real.log_lt_log (by positivity) (by linarith [Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hxy])

name: softplus_lipschitz
stmt: theorem softplus_lipschitz (x y : ℝ) : |softplus x - softplus y| ≤ 1 * |x - y|
proof:
by
  have hf : ∀ z : ℝ, z ∈ Set.univ → DifferentiableAt ℝ softplus z :=
    fun z _ => (softplus_hasDerivAt z).differentiableAt
  have hbound : ∀ z : ℝ, z ∈ Set.univ → ‖deriv softplus z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro z _
    rw [softplus_deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sigmoid_bounds z).1]
    exact le_of_lt (sigmoid_bounds z).2
  have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le (x := x) (y := y) (s := Set.univ)
    hf hbound convex_univ trivial trivial
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm] using hmvt

name: sigmoid_deriv_pos
stmt: theorem sigmoid_deriv_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < deriv sigmoid x
proof:
by
  rw [sigmoid_deriv]
  exact mul_pos (sigmoid_bounds x).1 (by linarith [(sigmoid_bounds x).2])

name: sigmoid_deriv_le_quarter
stmt: theorem sigmoid_deriv_le_quarter (x : ℝ) : deriv sigmoid x ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
by
  rw [sigmoid_deriv]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sigmoid x - 1 / 2), (sigmoid_bounds x).1, (sigmoid_bounds x).2]

name: tanh_deriv_nonneg
stmt: theorem tanh_deriv_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ deriv Real.tanh x
proof:
by
  rw [tanh_deriv]
  have h : Real.tanh x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).mpr (tanh_abs_le_one x)
  linarith

name: tanh_deriv_le_one
stmt: theorem tanh_deriv_le_one (x : ℝ) : deriv Real.tanh x ≤ 1
proof:
by
  rw [tanh_deriv]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.tanh x)]

name: hardSigmoid_eq_linear_of_mem
doc: `|x| < 3` 时 hardSigmoid 退化为线性函数 `x/6 + 1/2`。
stmt:
theorem hardSigmoid_eq_linear_of_mem {x : ℝ} (h1 : -3 < x) (h2 : x < 3) :
    hardSigmoid x = x / 6 + 1 / 2
proof:
by
  unfold hardSigmoid
  have hpos : 0 ≤ x / 6 + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hle : x / 6 + 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
  rw [max_eq_right hpos, min_eq_right hle]

name: hardSigmoid_hasDerivAt_linear
doc: **hardSigmoid 在线性段 `(-3,3)` 内可导且导数为 `1/6`**。
stmt:
theorem hardSigmoid_hasDerivAt_linear {x : ℝ} (h1 : -3 < x) (h2 : x < 3) :
    HasDerivAt hardSigmoid (1 / 6) x
proof:
by
  have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t / 6 + 1 / 2) (1 / 6) x := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id x).div_const 6).const_add (1 / 2)
    simpa [add_comm] using h
  have hev : hardSigmoid =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun t : ℝ => t / 6 + 1 / 2 := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩] with t ht
    exact hardSigmoid_eq_linear_of_mem ht.1 ht.2
  exact hlin.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev

name: geluInner
stmt: def geluInner (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x ^ 3)

name: geluInner_hasDerivAt
stmt:
theorem geluInner_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt geluInner (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2)) x
proof:
by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t + 0.044715 * t ^ 3)
      (1 + 0.044715 * (3 * x ^ 2)) x := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t) 1 x := hasDerivAt_id x
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 0.044715 * t ^ 3) (0.044715 * (3 * x ^ 2)) x := by
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 3) ((3 : ℝ) * x ^ (3 - 1)) x := hasDerivAt_pow 3 x
      simpa using hp.const_mul 0.044715
    exact h1.add h2
  have hres := hinner.const_mul (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi))
  have hval : Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 0.044715 * (3 * x ^ 2))
      = Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [hval] at hres
  show HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (y + 0.044715 * y ^ 3))
    (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2)) x
  exact hres

name: geluSoftMask_hasDerivAt
doc: GELU-tanh 软掩码 `0.5 * (1 + tanh (geluInner x))` 的导数。
stmt:
theorem geluSoftMask_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt geluSoftMask
      (0.5 * ((1 - Real.tanh (geluInner x) ^ 2)
        * (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2)))) x
proof:
by
  have htanh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.tanh (geluInner t))
      ((1 - Real.tanh (geluInner x) ^ 2)
        * (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2))) x :=
    (tanh_hasDerivAt (geluInner x)).comp x (geluInner_hasDerivAt x)
  have h := (htanh.const_add 1).const_mul 0.5
  simpa [geluSoftMask] using h

name: geluTanh_hasDerivAt
doc: **GELU-tanh 的导数（乘积法则 + 链式法则）**：`geluTanh x = x · geluSoftMask x`。
stmt:
theorem geluTanh_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt geluTanh
      (geluSoftMask x + x * (0.5 * ((1 - Real.tanh (geluInner x) ^ 2)
        * (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2))))) x
proof:
by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id x).mul (geluSoftMask_hasDerivAt x)
  simpa [geluTanh] using h

name: geluTanhDeriv
doc: GELU-tanh 导数的闭式（链式法则的结果）。
stmt: noncomputable def geluTanhDeriv (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof:
geluSoftMask x + x * (0.5 * ((1 - Real.tanh (geluInner x) ^ 2)
    * (Real.sqrt (2 / Real.pi) * (1 + 3 * 0.044715 * x ^ 2))))

name: geluTanh_deriv
stmt: theorem geluTanh_deriv (x : ℝ) : deriv geluTanh x = geluTanhDeriv x
proof:
(geluTanh_hasDerivAt x).deriv

end Lattice

name: bmean
stmt: def bmean (X : ι → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: (∑ i, X i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)

name: bcenter
stmt: def bcenter (X : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => X i - bmean X

name: bvar
stmt: def bvar (X : ι → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i, (bcenter X i) ^ 2

name: bnorm
stmt: def bnorm (X : ι → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun i => bcenter X i / Real.sqrt (bvar X)

name: bmean_scale
stmt:
lemma bmean_scale (X : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    bmean (fun i => α * X i) = α * bmean X
proof:
by
  unfold bmean
  by_cases hc : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [hc]
  · calc
      (∑ i, α * X i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) = (α * ∑ i, X i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = α * ((∑ i, X i) / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hc]

name: bcenter_scale
stmt:
lemma bcenter_scale (X : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    bcenter (fun i => α * X i) = fun i => α * bcenter X i
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold bcenter
  calc
    α * X i - bmean (fun j => α * X j) = α * X i - α * bmean X := by rw [bmean_scale X α]
    _ = α * (X i - bmean X) := by ring

name: bvar_scale
stmt:
lemma bvar_scale (X : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    bvar (fun i => α * X i) = α ^ 2 * bvar X
proof:
by
  unfold bvar
  have hc : bcenter (fun j => α * X j) = fun i => α * bcenter X i := bcenter_scale X α
  calc
    (∑ i, (bcenter (fun j => α * X j) i) ^ 2) = ∑ i, (α * bcenter X i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hc]
    _ = α ^ 2 * ∑ i, (bcenter X i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      ring

name: bnorm_scale_invariant
stmt:
theorem bnorm_scale_invariant (X : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    bnorm (fun i => α * X i) = bnorm X
proof:
by
  funext i
  unfold bnorm
                                      
  have hnum : bcenter (fun j => α * X j) i = α * bcenter X i := congrFun (bcenter_scale X α) i
  have hden : Real.sqrt (bvar (fun j => α * X j)) = α * Real.sqrt (bvar X) := by
    rw [bvar_scale X α]
    have hαsq : 0 ≤ α ^ 2 := sq_nonneg α
    have hv : 0 ≤ bvar X := by
      unfold bvar
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k hk => sq_nonneg _)
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (α ^ 2) = α := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs α]
      exact abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hα)
    calc
      Real.sqrt (α ^ 2 * bvar X) = Real.sqrt (α ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (bvar X) := by
        exact Real.sqrt_mul hαsq (bvar X)
      _ = α * Real.sqrt (bvar X) := by rw [hsqrt]
  calc
    bcenter (fun j => α * X j) i / Real.sqrt (bvar (fun j => α * X j))
        = (α * bcenter X i) / (α * Real.sqrt (bvar X)) := by rw [hnum, hden]
    _ = bcenter X i / Real.sqrt (bvar X) := by
      exact mul_div_mul_left (bcenter X i) (Real.sqrt (bvar X)) (ne_of_gt hα)

name: infer_bn_is_affine
stmt:
theorem infer_bn_is_affine (μ σ γ β ε : ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ => γ * (x - μ) / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε) + β) =
    fun x : ℝ => (γ / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε)) * x + (β - γ * μ / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε))
proof:
by
  funext x
                                                                     
  by_cases hs : Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε) = 0
  · simp [hs]
  · field_simp [hs]
    ring

name: infer_bn_slope_intercept
stmt:
theorem infer_bn_slope_intercept (μ σ γ β ε : ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ => γ * (x - μ) / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε) + β) =
    fun x : ℝ => (γ / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε)) * x + (β - γ * μ / Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2 + ε))
proof:
infer_bn_is_affine μ σ γ β ε

end Lattice
